related.title: 矽電子搬運：長距離自旋保留率
related.titleEn: Silicon electron shuttling: spin survival over many transfers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以±0.1mV和±0.2mV四點共同驗證曲率，不能僅靠單次零斜率就宣稱免疫電荷雜訊。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Validate curvature with all four±0.1/±0.2mV points; one zero-slope measurement does not establish charge-noise immunity. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 從每次搬運誤差推算累積保留率，區分存活與相位相干。
related.differenceEn: Propagate per-transfer errors into survival while distinguishing population survival from phase coherence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。κ=10MHz/mV²，靜態電壓偏差δV=0.1mV。 Δf=0.5×κ×δV²。 代入 0.5*10*0.1**2，得到 0.05 MHz。甜蜜點附近f(V)=f₀+κδV²/2，κ固定且三階項忽略；超出局部範圍不可外插。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每次搬運翻轉率p=0.001，總搬運N=100；僅計算未出現任何翻轉的機率。 P無翻轉=0.999^100。 代入 0.999**100，得到 0.904792 dimensionless。獨立等機率錯誤下P保留=(1−p)^N；相關錯誤或相干誤差不符合此乘法。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. κ=10MHz/mV² and static voltage offsetδV=0.1mV. Δf=0.5×κ×δV². Substituting 0.5*10*0.1**2 gives 0.05 MHz. Near a sweet spot f(V)=f0+κδV²/2 with constantκ and neglected cubic terms; do not extrapolate beyond the local range. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-transfer flip probabilityp=0.001 andN=100 transfers; calculate the probability of no flip, not final parity. Pno-flip=0.999^100. Substituting 0.999**100 gives 0.904792 dimensionless. For equal independent error probabilityPsurvival=(1−p)^N; correlated or coherent errors violate this product. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
